description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Efficiency of Roof-Integrated Aerodynamic Mitigation and Power System (AMPS) for Low-Rise Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joshua Del Bosque, Texas State University (txstate.edu). This project is the efficiency of roof-integrated aerodynamic mitigation and power system (AMPS) for low-rise buildings and assessing the aerodynamic and mitigation behaviors on the roof. The project is tested under restricted movement or static conditions to simulate under storming conditions, and can be useful for researchers interested in how AMPS performs under storming wind-loads. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-15g2-wq28. Keywords: NSF NHERI FIU Wall of Wind, Aerodynamic Mitigation and Power System, AMPS. Published 2024-08-15. Facility named: Wall of Wind - Florida International University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
